subject.title: feat(cli-output): emit thinking_delta events; handle redacted single-block shape

question: Should Claude CLI thinking deltas become an OpenClaw reasoning event that downstream channels and APIs may display when the existing reasoning-visibility setting permits it, while opaque redacted blocks remain suppressed?
rationale: The parser mechanism is straightforward, but making model thinking observable establishes a privacy and product contract that cannot safely be inferred from this partial draft or its now-closed downstream PRs.

options.title: Expose through reasoning policy
options.body: Adopt thinking deltas only through the existing opt-in reasoning-visibility path and never surface opaque redacted block data.

options.title: Keep CLI thinking internal
options.body: Reject the new observable callback and continue exposing only assistant text and structured tool events from Claude CLI streams.

options.title: Parser seam only
options.body: Permit an internal callback now but require a separate approved design before any channel, gateway, or plugin consumer may use it.

recommendation.title: Expose through reasoning policy
recommendation.body: Adopt thinking deltas only through the existing opt-in reasoning-visibility path and never surface opaque redacted block data.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior crosses the Claude CLI live-session boundary introduced in their prior work, making them the strongest feature-history routing candidate.
